description: Admit raw PostgreSQL query execution through the owned job worker. Returns data.job_id and data.status; read the exact job id with job_service.get_job for the complete records/count response or typed failure.
embedding_description: Execute parameterized SQL on PostgreSQL through one owned job operation shared with state_service.execute_sql. The registered endpoint returns an AsyncJobManager receipt before SQL runs. Use job_service.get_job with the canonical id; job.result contains the complete original ActionResult with records and count and job.error retains failures. Direct internal execute_sql remains synchronous.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Completed SQL job outcome containing the original records/count response; initial dispatch returns only a job receipt
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Retain data.job_id and read service_interface::job_service::get_job until terminal. Read records from job.result.data and handle job.error before continuing.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Executing raw SQL query on PostgreSQL database
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: SQLError: invalid SQL syntax or query execution failed. PermissionError: insufficient privileges for the operation. ConnectionError: PostgreSQL connection failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For SQL errors: verify SQL syntax is valid PostgreSQL. For permission errors: check database user privileges. For connection errors: verify PostgreSQL is running and accessible.
